module.purpose: Provides brand-color normalization, validation, palette generation, and WCAG contrast selection for embedded theming.
module.summary: This module transforms light and dark brand color inputs into normalized six-digit hexadecimal values, generates lighter and darker palette shades, selects readable foreground colors using luminance and contrast calculations, and exposes a hook that assembles light and dark theme tokens. It also validates hexadecimal input and falls back to configured defaults.
module.businessContext: Supports branded embedded scheduling interfaces. If color processing fails, embeds may render invalid CSS colors or unreadable text, degrading customer branding and accessibility.
functions: fallBackHex (~L19-24): Returns a valid supplied color or the appropriate default brand color.
isValidHexCode (~L26-34): Checks whether a string matches supported hexadecimal color syntax.
getValidHEX (~L37-45): Validates hexadecimal input and returns a fallback when invalid.
hexToRgb (~L47-64): Converts a six-digit hexadecimal color into numeric RGB channels.
rgbToHex (~L66-69): Converts numeric RGB channels into a hexadecimal color string.
lighten (~L71-83): Blends a hexadecimal color toward white by an intensity factor.
darken (~L85-97): Scales hexadecimal RGB channels by a darkening intensity factor.
normalizeHexCode (~L99-118): Removes prefixes and expands shorthand hexadecimal color values.
createColorMap (~L120-146): Builds brand palette shades for light and dark intensity levels.
getWCAGContrastColor (~L148-156): Chooses black or white text based on background luminance.
checkWCAGContrastColor (~L158-174): Determines whether two colors meet the minimum contrast ratio.
useGetBrandingColours (~L180-217): Produces light and dark branded theme tokens from embed colors.
systemCapabilities: Compose light and dark theme tokens
